record.question: A rectangular piece of paper with side lengths 5 by 8 is folded along the dashed lines shown below, so that the folded flaps just touch at the corners as shown by the dotted lines. Find the area of the resulting trapezoid.

original_record.question: A rectangular piece of paper with side lengths 5 by 8 is folded along the dashed lines shown below, so that the folded flaps just touch at the corners as shown by the dotted lines. Find the area of the resulting trapezoid.\n<image1>
original_record.solution: Drawing the perpendiculars from the point of intersection of the corners to the bases of the trapezoid, we see that we have similar 3-4-5 right triangles, and we can calculate that the length of the smaller base is 3 . Thus the area of the trapezoid is $\frac{8+3}{2} \cdot 5=55 / 2$.
